title: Flaky Foie Gras Kebabs
description: A twist on traditional foie gras, this recipe combines the luxurious ingredient with the flavors of Indian cuisine in a kebab format.
instructions: Cut the foie gras into small cubes and set aside.
Roll out the flaky pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut the pastry into 4 equal squares.
Place a cube of foie gras in the center of each pastry square.
Sprinkle a pinch of Indian spice blend over the foie gras.
Place a piece of ginger and a clove of garlic on top of the foie gras.
Drizzle a small amount of soy sauce and honey over the top.
Fold the pastry squares in half to form triangles.
Brush the edges with a little water and press to seal.
Grill the kebabs for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the pastry is golden brown.
